_doc: Maps a TARGET language (BCP-47 corpus code, e.g. 'es', 'ja', 'pa-Arab') to its PERSONA PROFILE: which name pool (content/identity/names.json), wardrobe theme (a WardrobeTheme id known to src/character/characterGen.ts), starter cosmetic kit (content/cosmetics/starter.json), and starter inventory grant (content/economy/starterGrants.json) a fresh Track of that target is BORN with. Pair Identity (R2-6). Resolved by src/identity/pairProfile.ts. Keyed on the TARGET because the persona is themed to the world you travel INTO (see PAIR_IDENTITY.md §1); for a single-language / immersion stack target===native, so the one language's pool is used (no special case). `_default` covers any target with no explicit row, so ALL 2,450 pairs work day one — explicit `targets` rows are a QUALITY upgrade for popular targets, NEVER a prerequisite. `themeId` is a SOFT HINT for the player's wardrobe only; the actual world/currency is chosen by the Scene/curriculum pipeline. CDN-overridable: a new pool/kit/grant/target is a catalog push, no app release. The resolver treats every id as possibly-unknown and substitutes the universal default with a loud warn.
